steps.content: The confrontation is brief.
Though not Sinners, the Kisugi sisters dismantle the thieves' attack with flawless coordination, making quick work of them.
Realizing they are utterly outmatched, Number Three screeches the car to the curb and frantically whisks the others away.
Hitomi... that still counts as self-defense, right?
I'd say so. This area really isn't safe after all.
Oh yeah—Rui, what were we talking about again before all that?
Why they call them the "Marauders."
Right! They must be those terrifying-looking Sinners, all savage and bloodthirsty—rawr!
Ai, your imagination is as wild as ever.
Chatting casually, the three sisters leave the alley.
It is a story they will likely never hear: the true origin of the Marauders and their name.

steps.speaker: Number Two
steps.content: Boss... you really oughta get those bleeding gums checked. Every time you eat a painting, your mouth ends up a mess... It's kinda unsettling.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: ...Like hell I will! Your face ain't on the wanted posters; mine is!

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Ugh... I need that painting! I missed it last time at the gallery... This time, I'm getting it for sure!!

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: I heard they're selling Mania weapons on the black market... Get my hands on one of those, and no one's stopping me! HAHAHA!!

steps.speaker: Number Three
steps.content: How about... we aim for something else, Boss? This is way too risky. Can't we just lift the usual stuff and fence it...?
The underlings look uneasy.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: That painting... that smell... I smell it every time I close my eyes! I wanna eat it. I wanna eat it so bad...!

steps.speaker: Number Four
steps.content: Boss... it's a painting. Not food.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Painting is food... Painting is life!!

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: ...I know you're all scared. Scared of MBCC, scared of that one in gray, scared of going back behind the bars.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: But I'm even more scared. Scared I'll never catch that scent again.
The crew stares, stunned; they've never seen the boss this unhinged. A tense silence hangs until Number Four breaks it, stepping forward.

steps.speaker: Number Four
steps.content: ...Boss, Mania weapons... that's not for people like us. Touch one, and it's a death sentence.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: A death sentence? Then so be it! If I can eat that painting, it'll be worth it!!

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Next time... Next time... I'll—

steps.speaker: Number Two
steps.content: Enough! Boss... snap out of it!
Number Two can't hold back. He steps forward and seizes the boss by the shoulder.
But as he presses down, an icy shock shoots through his palm. His heart plummets. This is no longer human skin.
